parameters.content:
MODULE 1 - INTAKE
All channels normalize to one lead shape + input validation.

MODULE 2 - AI QUALIFICATION
Deterministic Gemini (temp 0), strict JSON, spam gate, score clamping.

MODULE 3 - DUPLICATE DETECTION + CRM
Multi-field match, agent assignment, upsert with full schema.

MODULE 4 - ROUTING + NOTIFICATIONS
Hot/Warm/Cold routing. Gmail + Slack alerts on hot leads.

MODULE 5 - BOOKING
Offer next 3 slots -> customer confirms -> event created. Reschedule/cancel supported.

MODULE 7 - FOLLOW-UP SEQUENCE ENGINE
Daily scan of CRM. Day 1/3/7/14 stages. Stops on reply/booking/opt-out.

MODULE 8 - AI LISTING WRITER
Generates 13 content variants per property.

MODULE 9 - ANALYTICS
Event log + scheduled summary rollup.

MODULE 10 - GLOBAL ERROR HANDLING
Catches failures from anywhere in the workflow.
